description: Generated by scripts/export_site_data.py. Do not edit by hand.

rules.title: VDA registration is failing because a controller name cannot be resolved
recommendations: Resolve every configured controller FQDN from the VDA.
Verify the VDA controller list and DNS suffix/search configuration.
Retry registration only after DNS answers are stable.

rules.title: StoreFront or Gateway rejected an STA ticket
any: cannot contact the Citrix XML Service
recommendations: Compare STA server lists and protocol settings on Gateway and StoreFront.
Verify connectivity and certificate trust from the validating component to each STA.
Correlate the failure timestamp across Gateway, StoreFront, and Delivery Controller logs.

rules.title: A profile container appears to be locked or already attached
recommendations: Confirm that the user has no stale session on another VDA.
Inspect the file-server handle before releasing a lock.
Validate profile-container exclusions and cleanup policy.

rules.title: Authentication is failing because system clocks differ
recommendations: Compare time, time zone, and NTP source on the affected host and domain controllers.
Restore time synchronization before retrying authentication.
Check the virtualization platform for conflicting guest time synchronization.
